messages:
sam: Quick question — we merged the telemetry dedupe PR yesterday. Should that be a patch bump (1.9.2) or a minor (1.10.0)? It's a bugfix but touches the public /metrics filter param.
marco: If it changes request params users rely on, it's minor. Patch = bugfix that doesn't alter API shape.
tia: If it's behind a feature flag, can we keep it patch?
elaine: @tia ops expects zero-diff routes; feature-flagged changes still count as new feature according to our semver policy (we covered this in the release playbook).
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v1.9.2 -> prod in 30m (canary rollout). CHANGES: cherry-picked bugfixes + telemetry dedupe (#4321)
sam: This keeps coming up. Proposal: patch = bugfix + docs only. Minor = any API param change or new opt-in behavior even behind a flag. Require PR label `release:minor` to force a minor bump.
marco: Sounds reasonable. Also, tagging: do we keep the `v` prefix? I prefer `v1.9.2` annotated signed tags so installers can verify.
tia: +1 to `v` prefix. Also include short sha in the annotated tag message (not in the semver itself). Example: `git tag -s v1.9.2 -m "release v1.9.2 (sha: abc123)"`.
elaine: Action items: update release checklist — enforce `release-note:` label in PR templates, and set the release-bot to block patch releases if any `api:` or `feat:` commits are present unless explicitly marked docs-only.
sam: Rollback policy note: for patches prefer cherry-pick hotfixes into the release branch. For minors that change API shape, prefer revert + follow-up release. Agree?
marco: :thumbsup: Agreed. Also require signed annotated tags for every production release.
ops-oncall: Reminder: change window is 09:00-17:00 UTC for prod deploys. Any deploy outside that needs manager + oncall ack.
sam: I'll open a tiny RFC to codify these rules: bump semantics, tag/signing convention, release-bot label checks, and rollback steps. cc @elaine @marco.
tia: For the immediate deploy — because this touches an API param I think we should bump minor and hold canary until morning. @deploy-bot can you pause the rollout?
deploy-bot: Canary paused. Deploy aborted per request. Waiting for new tag.
elaine: Nice catch, thanks. Avoided a risky change. Ping #eng-releases when the RFC is up.
